versions.changelog: v1.1: Refactored to background polling — research_start, poll-research, and save-report split into separate scripts. Agent sets up task and exits immediately; a background Bash process handles polling. Matches the notebooklm-content-creation pattern.

Initial release: MCP-based deep research using the gemini-deep-research extension. Supports Comprehensive Research Report, Executive Brief, and Technical Deep Dive formats. Outputs to Obsidian or any specified path.
